subject: November ED Nursing Master Schedule Released
body: Hi David, the November shift roster has been finalized. Attached is hospital_monthly_shift_roster.pdf. You are scheduled for day shifts the first and third weeks, and night shifts Nov 9 through 11.
Hey David, picked up Leo from after-school care and he is having dinner at my place. How was your shift?
Shift was busy with triage admissions. Coming over to pick him up now, thanks so much Hanna!

subject: Appointment Reminder: Leo Kim Tomorrow at 10:30 AM
body: Dear David, this is a reminder for Leo Kim asthma follow-up with Dr. Angela Gomez tomorrow, Friday Nov 6 at 10:30 AM. Please bring his current inhaler.

subject: Leo Kim Clinic Visit Summary & Inhaler Action Plan
body: Hi David, Leo lungs sounded clear today. I renewed his Albuterol sulfate 90mcg inhaler prescription. The clinic visit summary (pediatric_clinic_visit_summary.pdf) is attached for your records.
Hey David! Are you working night shift this coming Monday Nov 9? Would you be open to swapping your night shift for my day shift next weekend?
Hey Carlos, I cannot do weekends because of Leo soccer tournaments, but I can swap if you have a weekday day shift.

subject: Parent-Teacher Conference Scheduled - Friday Nov 13 at 3:30 PM
body: Dear Mr. Kim, your 2nd grade parent conference for Leo is confirmed for Friday Nov 13 at 3:30 PM in Room 14. Leo is excelling in reading and mathematics!
Just woke up from post-night shift sleep. Feeling much better! Heading to pick up Leo from after-school care now.
Hey David, I heard you were looking to take Thanksgiving off. Rachel approved me covering Thanksgiving Day if you can take my shift on Nov 30.
That is an amazing deal Carlos! Thank you so much, that lets me spend the full holiday with Leo and my sister. I will take Nov 30 for you.

subject: Shift Swap Approved: Thanksgiving Day Coverage
body: David, Carlos Mendez coverage of your Thanksgiving shift has been logged into the hospital portal. You are confirmed off on Nov 26 and scheduled for Unit 3B day shift on Nov 30.
Happy Thanksgiving! Leo is already helping me make mashed potatoes. See you at noon!

subject: Thank you for covering Unit 3B today
body: Hi David, thanks for stepping in for Carlos today. Your BLS recertification credits were also processed by HR. Great work this month!
